title: Blink vs Cursor: AI App Builder vs AI Code Editor (Honest 2026 Comparison)
summary: Cursor is the best AI code editor for developers editing existing codebases. Blink is the best option for shipping new full-stack products — database, auth, and deploy included. Here's the honest comparison.
body_markdown: Cursor gives more low-level control — you see every file, every line, and can override anything the AI generates. That is genuinely valuable for developers who need to make precise infrastructure decisions or maintain a specific code architecture.[Blink](https://blink.new/) prioritizes shipping speed over low-level access, but you can connect a GitHub repo on any plan and Blink keeps it in two-way sync, so the code is yours to export, fork, or self-host. For 80% of new product use cases, Blink's defaults are the right choice. For the remaining 20% that need custom infrastructure configuration, Cursor wins on control — but you own all of it yourself.
